title: 第2章 转职：奸商
slug: 顶级奸商无敌从贩卖军火开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

【恭喜你触发唯一隐藏职业：奸商！】

【注：转职后将无法再更改职业，请谨慎选择！】

【职业：奸商】

【简介：转职成奸商之后，无法学习任何战斗技能，无法使用普通攻击，只能雇佣打手保护自己！】

【奸商职业被动：免税（摆摊，交易，拍卖行，店铺等，不再收取任何税收）】

【被动：移动摊位（摆摊将享受金字招牌，摆摊将不受地区限制，可以在危险区域摆摊）】

【被动：包裹加倍（包裹数量是普通玩家的一倍）】

【唯一主动技能：召唤打手】

【一旦选择，无法更改，请慎重选择！】

隐藏职业，奸商。

条件又苛刻又简单。

只有刚进入游戏，并且没有杀死一个怪，身上没有任务，才能在新手村酒馆老板娘处触发。

唯一的办法就像林风一样，进游戏就放弃任务。

奸商职业看起来很废材，但是，对林风来说很重要。

“确定选择！”

【叮，恭喜玩家商天子，转职为唯一隐藏职业：奸商！】

【叮，获得转职奖励：1000金币。】

【获得转职装备：行商步鞋！】

话音刚落。

林风的技能栏全部消失。

包裹里多出1000金币，一双布鞋。

不愧是隐藏职业，竟然直接给1000金币。

《天下》中的货币和现实金钱是互通的。

比例是1：10。

1000金币相当于100块钱。

那双鞋子属性也不错。

【行商步鞋：舒适的舔狗皮制造，耐久实用，可提高移动速度。】

【品级：蓝色】

【等级要求：0级】【职业要求：奸商】

【移动速度+4】

【生命恢复+1】

【装备评分：142分（绑定无法交易）】

这两个属性都是非常实用的属性。

【自动接取职业任务：招募打手】

【任务介绍：作为奸商，要应对危险情况，找到酒馆老帮娘，招募打手！】

系统声音终于停下。

酒馆老板娘嫣然一笑：“勇敢的年轻人，行走天下，保护自己最重要，我这里有三个打手供你选择！”

林风的面前出现三张卡片。

分别是白色卡片：黑风寨悍匪（战士）。

白色卡片：拿斧头的萝莉（战士）。

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

[Congratulations on triggering the only hidden profession: profiteer!】

[Note: You will no longer be able to change your profession after changing jobs, please choose carefully!】

[Occupation: profiteer]

[Introduction: After changing jobs to become a profiteer, you cannot learn any combat skills, cannot use normal attacks, and can only hire thugs to protect yourself!】

[Profiteer occupation passive: tax-free (stalls, transactions, auction houses, shops, etc., no more taxes will be charged)]

[Passive: Mobile stalls (stalls will enjoy the golden sign, stalls will not be restricted by region, and stalls can be set up in dangerous areas)]

[Passive: Double the number of packages (the number of packages is twice that of ordinary players)]

[The only active skill: Summoning thugs]

[Once selected, it cannot be changed, please choose carefully!】

Hidden profession, profiteer.

The conditions are harsh yet simple.

Only when you have just entered the game, have not killed a monster, and have no tasks, can you trigger it from the proprietress of the tavern in Novice Village.

The only way is like Lin Feng, to give up the mission as soon as you enter the game.

The profiteer profession seems useless, but it is very important to Lin Feng.

"Confirm your choice!"

[Ding, congratulations to player Shang Tianzi, who changed his job to the only hidden profession: profiteer!】

[Ding, get the job transfer reward: 1,000 gold coins.】

[Obtain job-changing equipment: Shang Shang Shoes!】

The words just fell.

Lin Feng's skill bar all disappeared.

There was an extra 1,000 gold coins in the package and a pair of cloth shoes.

As expected of a hidden profession, he was actually given 1,000 gold coins directly.

Currency and real money in "Tianxia" are interoperable.

The ratio is 1:10.

1,000 gold coins are equivalent to 100 yuan.

The properties of those shoes are also good.

[Hongshang walking shoes: Made of comfortable licking dog leather, durable and practical, can increase moving speed.】

[Grade: blue]

[Level Requirement: Level 0] [Occupational Requirement: Profiteer]

[Movement speed +4]

[Life recovery +1]

[Equipment score: 142 points (bound and cannot be traded)]

Both of these properties are very useful properties.

[Automatically accept professional tasks: Recruiting thugs]

[Task introduction: As a profiteer, you have to deal with dangerous situations, find the old gangster of the tavern, and recruit thugs!】

The system sound finally stopped.

The tavern proprietress smiled brightly: "You brave young man, when traveling around the world, the most important thing is to protect yourself. I have three thugs here for you to choose from!"

Three cards appeared in front of Lin Feng.

They are white cards: Black Wind Village Bandit (Warrior).

White card: Loli (warrior) with an axe.
